items.author: danielrosehill
items.description:
Sample Voice Context Data
	

A small synthetic dataset containing LLM-generated context information simulating a job seeker narrating their career trajectory.

	
		
	
	
		Purpose
	

This dataset was created to test a voice-to-vector-database RAG pipeline. The workflow being evaluated involves:

Voice data (MP3 recordings) transcribed to text
Transcriptions reformatted as structured context data
Text data upserted into a vector database (Pinecone or Ragie)
Retrieval accuracy tested… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/danielrosehill/Sample-Voice-Context-Data.

items.author: danielrosehill
items.description:
Proofed ASR Cleanup Training Data
	

Audio paired with clean, proofed target text for training an ASR model to do its own
post-processing: no fillers, repeats or false starts, numbers and money as digits, self-corrections
applied, asides to other people left out, paragraph breaks, whispered speech. Built for
Proofed, a fine-tune of NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2
that writes clean text in one pass with no LLM afterwards.

items.author: danielrosehill
items.description:
Annotated Voice Notes
	

Write-up: Datasets for fine-tuning speech recognition on your own voice
A small, hand-picked set of real voice notes. It is kept small on purpose. Each
note has its audio, a raw AssemblyAI transcript, and a written annotation that
explains why it was included and what it is good for.
This is not a bulk corpus. Every recording was chosen because it shows something
specific, such as tasks buried in rambling speech, heavy disfluency, or a long
take. The… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/danielrosehill/Annotated-Voice-Notes.
